systems.name: Brush
systems.tldr: Adjusted the placement of the 3 brushes in the center of the bridge to be exactly equidistant so Blue team no longer has a half-Teemo's worth of distance advantage when running to their brush.
systems.gameplayImpact: Brush loses power in the listed areas. Mains should adjust builds/play patterns; counters get an easier time.

systems.name: Turrets
systems.tldr: Removed: Turret rubble has been removed from the game.; New Effect: Turrets now begin to decay resistances at 30:00 and health at 45:00 in Clash.
systems.gameplayImpact: Turrets was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.
